answer: Mount Morgan (GSQ site 494270): live point queries to the official services on 2026-11-21, matching the site point (point-in-polygon) and anything within 2 km of it; each record says which. Tenure: 1 over the site point: ML 5623 (HERITAGE MINERALS PTY LTD; Granted, Renewal Lodged; granted 1974-05-15, expiry 2025-08-30; over the site point); 25 more within 2 km (for example EPM 17850 (GBM RESOURCES LIMITED; Granted; granted 2010-04-15, expiry 2027-04-14; within 2 km); ML 5589 (HERITAGE MINERALS PTY LTD; Granted, Renewal Lodged; granted 1974-05-15, expiry 2025-08-30; within 2 km); ML 5602 (HERITAGE MINERALS PTY LTD; Granted, Renewal Lodged; granted 1974-05-15, expiry 2025-08-30; within 2 km)). Note: tenure: Mining lease (ML) has 30 records within 2 km; the first 25 (those over the site point first) are listed; tenure: Mining lease surface area has 30 records within 2 km; the first 25 (those over the site point first) are listed. A tenure expiry date, or the absence of a tenure, does not establish that the ground is available; that needs legal confirmation. Native title records are as published by the NNTT on the checked date.
